description: Known legacy-side disagreements between a legacy typed field and its view over CardTemplate.effects (design doc 2026-09-29, section 10, 'Known legacy-side disagreements' and 'Further seed rows from the E0 integration review'). Each row explains every comparison of one of its fields on a card whose printed text (every face, lowercased) matches its pattern; the first matching row wins. A row that explains nothing on a full pool run is stale and fails `tools/effect_spec_equivalence.py --check`. A SEMANTIC_FIX row names its test. `unsurfaced` lists the section-10 rows no field comparison surfaces, with the reason, so every seed row is accounted for.

rows.reason: "target nonland permanent card from <zone>" is a battlefield requirement in target_solver._PERMANENT_PATTERN; the target is the card in that zone (CR 115.1). "target permanent card from ..." without "nonland" is already a graveyard requirement. Legacy fix: a target_solver unit, not E0.
rows.source: design doc section 10, known legacy-side disagreements, row 1

rows.reason: "target spell or creature": legacy reqs[0] is the stack only; the requirement is the union {stack, battlefield} (A21 target.zone_union), which the grammar refuses rather than narrowing.
rows.source: design doc section 10, known legacy-side disagreements, row 2

rows.reason: "nonland permanent or suspended card" spans {battlefield, exile} (CR 702.62a); legacy keeps the battlefield member only.
rows.source: design doc section 10, known legacy-side disagreements, row 3

rows.reason: A graveyard-or-exile object spans {graveyard, exile}; legacy keeps one zone.
rows.source: design doc section 10, known legacy-side disagreements, row 4

rows.reason: parse_ritual_mana also reads an add-mana phrase inside reminder text (a Treasure's) or a quoted granted ability; neither is the card's own mana effect, so the view gives None (section 10.1 landing note: ritual_mana's legacy parser also reads reminder and granted text).
rows.source: design doc section 10, ritual mana row; section 10.1 views-landed note

rows.reason: parse_ritual_mana reads "add an additional {C}" as two; the printed effect adds one ({C}x1).
rows.source: design doc section 10, further seed rows, ritual mana

rows.reason: "Equip / Dash / Unlock costs you pay cost {N} less" and "Plotting cards from your hand costs {2} less" are stored as {'target': 'all', ...}, a reduction of every spell; they are scoped to that keyword's cost or special action (CR 601.2f, 118.7). The grammar refuses them (payload.cost_delta_subject).
rows.source: design doc section 10, further seed rows, keyword-scoped cost reductions

rows.reason: A pump spell whose 'gains/has' window names two or more keywords: oracle_parser._pt_mod_keyword returns the first member of the _KEYWORD_WORDS set literal found in the window, so the legacy keyword is decided by the process's hash seed, not by printed order, and the comparison is none. The row classes every comparison on these cards (an equal one included) so the pinned counts are seed-free. The legacy fix (a printed-order pick) changes game behaviour: a legacy unit, not E0.
rows.source: design doc section 10, hash-order legacy value (follow-up review 2026-10-02)

rows.reason: parse_has_pump_grant reads a static P/T modifier ('this creature gets +2/+0', 'equipped creature gets +1/+0') as a pump grant; the view's pump grant is a MODIFY_PT until end of turn (a pump spell or ability). Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: The legacy team grant reads a keyword grant to a typed subset ('other historic creatures you control'), applying only during your turn, as a grant to the team; the view's team filter does not type 'historic' and reads only unconditional grants. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: parse_has_may_play_or_cast reads 'you may cast' inside a keyword's reminder text (disguise, flashback, retrace, warp); the reminder is not the card's own permission, and the view reads PERMIT specs only. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: The legacy flag reads a permission to cast cards from the graveyard (granted flashback, retrace) and a graveyard-activated cost ('Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card') as recursion; the view's recursion is a MOVE out of the graveyard to hand or battlefield. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: parse_has_token_effect reads 'create ... token' inside a keyword's reminder text (mobilize, job select, For Mirrodin!); the keyword is a KEYWORD host the grammar does not expand into specs, so the view sees no CREATE_TOKEN. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: An equip grant printed under 'during your turn' ('During your turn, equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has first strike') applies only on its controller's turn (CR 611.3a). The legacy equip parser reads it as unconditional; the view reads only unconditional 'equipped creature ...' statics. The frame was refused (FILTER) until the cast-timing unit typed it as the TURN condition, so the pair counted as UNMODELLED_CLAUSE.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: The legacy flag reads damage text with no target -- combat damage to a player, damage to each opponent, 'dealt damage by', or reminder text ('It deals combat damage before ...', 'Attach to target creature') -- as targeted damage; the view requires a DAMAGE spec with a target slot. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: The legacy flag reads 'destroy' / 'exile' inside reminder text (shield counter, flashback, warp, madness) and in a cost that exiles the card itself; the view reads DESTROY / EXILE effect specs. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: The legacy flag reads a cost that exiles the card itself from its owner's graveyard ('Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card') as graveyard hate; the view reads an EXILE effect on graveyard cards. Masked until 2026-10-09 by an unrelated refused 'during your turn' static on the same card (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the cast-timing unit types that frame as the TURN condition, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing 'during your turn' (2026-10-09)

rows.reason: The legacy flag reads damage with no target ('deals 1 damage to each opponent') as targeted damage; the view requires a DAMAGE spec with a target slot. Masked until 2026-10-10 by the card's refused 'exile the top N cards of your library' (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the impulse unit types that library position as the exile's object, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing library positions (2026-10-10)

rows.pattern: exile the top[\s\S]*(?:you may play|you may cast|play those cards|cast them)
rows.reason: The legacy flag counts impulse draw ('exile the top ... you may play / you may cast') as a draw by design (parse_has_draw_effect, whose predicate this pattern mirrors: card advantage for the AI); the view reads DRAW specs, and an exile with a permission to play is no draw (CR 121.1). Masked until 2026-10-10 by the refused library position and permission on the same host; the impulse unit types both, which unmasks the pairs.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing library positions (2026-10-10)

rows.reason: The legacy flags read 'exile all creature cards from your graveyard' together with 'put a creature card exiled with ~ onto the battlefield' as graveyard recursion and reanimation; the card returns from exile (a linked MOVE), never from the graveyard, which is what the views read. Masked until 2026-10-10 by the card's refused 'exile the top N cards of your library' (the UNMODELLED_CLAUSE class takes any refusal on a host the derivation reads); the impulse unit types that library position as the exile's object, which unmasks the pair.
rows.source: design doc section 10, rows unmasked by typing library positions (2026-10-10)

unsurfaced.reason: target_solver._NUMBER_WORDS stops at ten; no pool instant or sorcery prints a target count above ten, so the cast_targets comparison never meets the shape. The grammar refuses such a slot (target.count_unread:<word>).
unsurfaced.source: design doc section 10, further seed rows, printed counts above ten

unsurfaced.reason: The token-spec disagreements (last creature subtype only, a keyword window running into other sentences, a different token than the create slot) live in the runtime token carrier, which is no template field with a FieldDerivation; the E4 family compares it.
unsurfaced.source: design doc section 10, further seed rows, token subtypes

unsurfaced.reason: Counting the activation cost's pips with the produced mana is reproduced by the named quirk predicate _legacy_ritual_cost_pips, and no pool card's multi-colour add disagrees after it, so the ritual_mana view equals legacy on these shapes.
unsurfaced.source: design doc section 10, further seed rows, ritual mana

unsurfaced.reason: The relative-clause filter ("card with the same name as that ..." read as subtypes) is in the part of tutor_data the partial view does not compare; the destinations it compares all agree.
unsurfaced.source: design doc section 10, further seed rows, activation tutor filter
